Qwen 3 235B A22B Instruct 2507 language model

Qwen 3 235B A22B Instruct 2507 is served by Cerebras over an OpenAI-compatible API. Requests are proxied through the UnitySVC gateway; you bring your own Cerebras API key, so token usage is billed by Cerebras directly and the service is free through UnitySVC.

Reach it through the UnitySVC gateway with your own Cerebras API key (the byok channel). The endpoint accepts both OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages requests — the gateway auto-detects the dialect, translates to the upstream, and returns the response in the format you sent. See the code examples for both styles.
